act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the law relating to Criminal Procedure.

section.heading: Summary trial by Magistrate of second class
section.html: The High Court may confer on any Magistrate invested with the powers of a Magistrate of the second class power to try summarily any offence which is punishable only with fine or with imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months with or without fine, and any abetment of or attempt to commit any such offence.
